scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run audit
scripts.validate: rm -rf .validate && mkdir -p .validate && git archive HEAD | tar -xf - -C .validate && /usr/share/omarchy/bin/omarchy-plugin-validate .validate && rm -rf .validate
scripts.install-dev: tar -cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.github --exclude=CLAUDE.md --exclude=AGENTS.md --exclude=node_modules --exclude=.superpowers --exclude=docs --exclude=test --exclude=.husky --exclude=.validate . | (rm -rf ~/.config/omarchy/plugins/scoop.oxidone && mkdir -p ~/.config/omarchy/plugins/scoop.oxidone && tar -xf - -C ~/.config/omarchy/plugins/scoop.oxidone) && omarchy-shell shell rescanPlugins
